mechanics.name: Basic eating
mechanics.description: Consume one owned food unit, applying its real nutrition and toxicity.

mechanics.name: Berry cultivation
mechanics.description: Consume one owned berry and one branch at your current forest or grassland cell to establish a persistent berry planting. First ripe unit after 24 rounds, then at most one every 12 rounds, ground stock ceiling 2 and lifetime production 6. Photosynthetic environmental energy is recorded. No additional tending. Harvest actual ripe ground stacks with the existing pickup interface on the planting cell; anyone may collect them. The occupied cell and production budget cannot be reset.

mechanics.name: Root cultivation
mechanics.description: Consume one owned root and one branch at your current grassland cell to establish a persistent root planting. First ripe unit after 12 rounds, then at most one every 12 rounds, ground stock ceiling 2 and lifetime production 6. Photosynthetic environmental energy is recorded. No additional tending. Harvest actual ripe ground stacks with the existing pickup interface on the planting cell; anyone may collect them. The occupied cell and production budget cannot be reset.

mechanics.name: Gather branches
mechanics.description: Requires an adjacent natural site with at least one available branch and inventory capacity. With ordinary action effort, transfer one branch from its finite stock into owned inventory. No tool or material cost. The branch remains available for later use; gathering depletes the site and does not establish regeneration.

mechanics.name: Build branch sleeping platform
mechanics.description: Spend four owned branches at your current unoccupied walkable cell to build a persistent stationary shared resting platform. Existing coevolution rules allow any walkable terrain and give rest +4 on the platform cell or an adjacent cell, using only the strongest available bonus and capped at energy 40. This is the executable shared-rest scope, broader than the requested forest/grassland and same-cell-only restrictions. Construction gives no immediate recovery, food, healing or regeneration.
